package.name: v2x_bridge_cpp
package.description:
BFMC V2X bridge — UDP receiver on port 5007 for semaphore + other-vehicle broadcasts, and TCP location uplink to the BFMC traffic-communication server. Pure C++, POSIX sockets, no extra deps.
Publishes: /v2x/semaphores (std_msgs/String JSON: {id,state,x,y}) /v2x/cars (std_msgs/String JSON: {id,x,y}) Subscribes: /vehicle/state (bfmc_msgs/VehicleState) — uplinked at configurable Hz
